hooks.command: if [ -n "$CLAUDE_AUTO_REVIEW" ]; then exit 0; fi; if git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet; then exit 0; fi; CLAUDE_AUTO_REVIEW=1 claude -p "/code-review medium" --allowedTools "Read Grep Glob Bash(git *)" > .claude/last-code-review.log 2>&1
hooks.statusMessage: Running automated code review on this change...
